providerDefault: MEDIA_RESOLUTION_UNSPECIFIED. On Gemini 3 that resolves to 1120 tokens per image, 70 per video frame, 560 per PDF page.
summary: Caps how many tokens each media input consumes, trading detail against latency and cost.
combines: Supported on: multimodal Gemini models, Gemini Developer API. The request-level field works everywhere; setting resolution on individual content items is exclusive to Gemini 3 models.
Gemini 3 token counts: low 280 image / 70 video / 280 plus native text PDF; medium 560 / 70 / 560 plus native text; high 1120 / 280 / 1120 plus native text; ultra_high 2240 image only.

The REST enum descriptions ("low = 64 tokens", "medium = 256 tokens", "high = zoomed reframing with 256 tokens") describe pre-Gemini-3 behavior and disagree with the current media-resolution guide. Trust the guide's table for Gemini 3.
`ultra_high` is per-content-item only and is what computer-use workloads need.
Recommended settings: `high` for images, `medium` for PDFs, `low` for general video, `high` for text-heavy video. For video, `low` and `medium` are treated identically.
Migrating to Gemini 3 defaults raises PDF token usage and lowers video token usage; drop the resolution explicitly if you start blowing the context window.
supportedModels: gemini reasoning models with thinkingMode google-budget or google-level
